profile.summary: Lancor Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops residential and commercial properties in India. It is also involved in the leasing of commercial properties and allied activities; and providing maintenance services and club memberships. The company was formerly known as DBS Properties Limited. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.
